confidence_notes: Two searches were run: one for the RBA rate and one for Siem Reap prices. The RBA rate is the 18 Nov 2026 observation. Food and drink anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living sources (crowdsourced and survey-based), which disagree somewhat. No reliable cocktail price was found, so the cocktail is estimated at about 3.5x the beer price, based on tourist-bar pricing. The wine glass is estimated from bottle prices of about $9-12, with imported wine at tourist restaurants marked up. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not from live listings, and vary by season. The reference window is July 2026, which is low season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Siem Reap aggregated price indexes, with Phnom Penh and Cambodian tourist-area pricing as the regional basis. Prices are USD-denominated in practice.
